primaryText: Der Bauer, der kein Pestizid verwendete, war jemals von dem Ernteertrag begeistert.
translation: The farmer who used no pesticide was ever amazed by the crop yield.
comment: Illusory licensing condition: negative quantifier inside the subject-extracted relative clause. Printed unmarked as one condition of the item template (7); the prose classes it with the ungrammatical conditions ("illusory licensing may occur in the conditions using negation in the RC"; "both former (ungrammatical) conditions"). The paper leaves its item conditions unmarked by design, so the prose classification is the judgment.
